Nunu

Jungle Sleeper

AP Jungle Nunu

How to play this build

In the jungle, Consume (Q) gives infinite sustain and steals objectives with Smite; gank with Ice Blast (E) which on AP bursts hard and slows. The channeled ult (Absolute Zero) nukes grouped enemies: hide it behind a wall or engage.

Skill order

Max priority:

E Bola de Hielo → Q Consumir → W Hervir Sangre

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Ice Blast (E) for AP burst on ganks; Consume (Q) second for sustain and objective steals with Smite.

Items and what they do

  1. Spirit of the Ancient Golem Tank jungle item: health, tenacity and the Smite buff (jungle sustain).
  2. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  3. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  4. Void Staff AP and % magic penetration; a must vs. enemies stacking MR.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Runes

In classic LoL, runes were a system SEPARATE from masteries: bought with IP (Influence Points) and slotted into 4 tiers — Marks (red), Seals (yellow), Glyphs (blue) and Quintessences (purple, the strongest). They gave flat stats: damage, armor, penetration, etc.

Marks (red) Magic penetration ×9
Seals (yellow) Armor ×9
Glyphs (blue) Magic resist per level ×9
Quintessences (purple) Ability power ×3

Magic pen, armor, AP quints

Masteries: how they work

In classic LoL you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 boosts Ice Blast and the ult with durability to channel.
